Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to the Governor's Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81248797116
Zoom Meeting ID: 812 4879 7116
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code 812 4879 7116#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email correspondence to CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all councilmembers. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the City Council during the meeting, please email CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org with (1) the agenda item on which you'd like to speak, and (2) the phone number and/or Zoom display name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will replace the in-person speaker cards. Please note: This will be the only way to sign up for public comment.

MINUTES
  OF THE SEPTEMBER 22, 2020 REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

 A Teleconference meeting of the Palos Verdes Estates City Council meeting via Zoom
 pursuant to Executive Order N25-20 issued by Governor Gavin Newsom on March 26, 2020,
 was called to order by Mayor McGowan at 6:31 P.M. on September 22, 2020, notice having
 been given with affidavit thereto on file. Members of the public were provided with the
 following information to provide public input:

  BY COMPUTER:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81248797116
  Zoom Meeting ID: 812 4879 7116
  BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code 812 4879 7116#

BY EMAIL: CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org

NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R20-32

NEXT ORDINANCE NO. O20-747

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE - waived

ROLL CALL
  Mayor McGowan, Mayor Pro Tem Kemps, Councilmembers Davidson, Kao and
  Lozzi

ABSENT: None

ALSO PRESENT:

  City Manager Guglielmo, City Attorney Hogin, Treasurer Ying, Acting Planning &
  Building Director Rindge, Interim Police Chief Dreiling, City Clerk Chaney

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Davidson, Seconded by Mayor Pro Tem
  Kemps to approve the agenda. The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  Lozzi, Kao, Davidson, Kemps, McGowan
  NOES:  None

MAYOR’S REPORT – MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST
The Mayor addressed resident concerns regarding maintenance issues in the City regarding fire
risk and trash in the City, and asked City Manager Guglielmo to address these concerns.
The Mayor also addressed resident concerns regarding Southern California Edison power
outages in the City. Concerns about the Palos Verdes Golf Club were also addressed.
Mayor McGowan introduced Ben Gardner and Danny Stender, who reported on their curb
painting and donating to PVE Cares.
Karen Logan addressed the City Council.

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
September 22, 2020
 CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 – 5)

  Councilmember Kao requested that Agenda item #7, the response to the Los
  Angeles County Grand Jury’s report be considered under the Consent Agenda.

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Davidson, Seconded by Councilmember
  Kao to approve the consent agenda. The motion carried by the following roll call
  vote:

  AYES:  Lozzi, Kao, Davidson, Kemps, McGowan
  NOES:  None

PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS ON CONSENT AGENDA

1.  City Council Action Minutes
  Approved:
  a.  September 8, 2020 Regular Meeting Minutes

2.  Approval of Warrant Registers – 9/22/2020

  Approved Warrant Registers: 09222020-A, 09222020-B, 09222020-C, 09182020-A

3.  Adoption of Resolution R20-29 Approving (1) Acceptance of PW-681-20 Palos
  Verdes Drive West Street Improvements Project (including Addison Road and
  Yarmouth Road); and (2) Authorizing the City Clerk to File The Notice of
  Completion for this Project; (3) Authorizing the Finance Director to Release the
  Retention and Make Final Accounting Entries for this Project in Fiscal Year
  2019/2020; and (4) Amending Resolution R20-09.

  Adopted Resolution R20-29: (1) Accepting PW-681-20 Palos Verdes Drive West
  Street Improvements Project (including Addison Road and Yarmouth Road), (2)
  Authorizing the City Clerk to file the Notice of Completion, (3) authorizing the
  Finance Director to release the retention 30 days after the County Recorder's office
  records the Notice of Completion and make final accounting entries for this project
  in Fiscal Year 2019/2020; and (4) Amending Resolution R20-09

4.  Adoption of Resolution R20-32: (1) Approving Program Supplement Agreement
  No. F006 for Funding of the PW-672-19 PVE Guardrail Project, Federal Project
  No. HSIPL-5283(010); (2) Authorizing the City Manager to Execute the
  Agreement on Behalf of the City

  Approved Program Supplement Agreement No. F006 for the funding of the PW-672-
  19 PVE Guardrail Project, Federal Project No. HSIPL-5283(010) and (2) authorized
  the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.

5.  Consideration of Traffic Safety Recommendations of September 2, 2020

  Approved the Traffic Safety Committee’s recommendations to have Streets and Parks
  staff paint the northeast corner curb return at the intersection of the Via Estudillo/Rico
  Place and Espinosa Circle red and have a contractor paint lead-in centerlines on all
  intersection approaches as part of the upcoming street resurfacing project.

7.  Response to the Los Angeles County Grand Jury’s Report Entitled “A Diet For
  Landfills: Cutting Down on Food Waste”

  Recommendation: (1) Approve the response letter to the Los Angeles County Grand
  Jury’s report entitled “A Diet for Landfills: Cutting Down on Food Waste;” and (2)
  Authorize the Mayor to sign the letter on behalf of the City of Palos Verdes Estates.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
September 22, 2020
 The following individuals addressed the City Council: Tom Bechler, Karen Logan, and Desiree
Myers.

PUBLIC PRESENTATIONS

  A. Presentation from Cox Communications – Infrastructure Upgrade
  Michael Hadland, Ingo Hentschel and Kristen Camuglia presented on behalf of Cox
  Communications.

CEREMONIAL MATTERS

PUBLIC HEARING(S)

6.  Ordinance No. O20-747 Affirming Urgency Ordinance No. O20-744u and Further
  Amending Chapter 18.45 (Accessory Dwelling Units) in the Palos Verdes Estates
  Municipal Code

  Acting Planning & Building Director Rindge presented.

  ACTION: Moved by Mayor Pro Tem Kemps, Seconded by Councilmember Kao
  to adopt Ordinance No. O20-747 Affirming Urgency Ordinance No. O20-744u and
  Further Amending Chapter 18.45 (Accessory Dwelling Units) in the Palos Verdes
  Estates Municipal Code, subject to the requirement that the Palos Verdes Homes
  Association shall be noticed upon receipt of applications. The motion carried by the
  following roll call vote:

  AYES:  Lozzi, Kao, Davidson, Kemps, McGowan
  NOES:  None

OLD BUSINESS

NEW BUSINESS

7.  Response to the Los Angeles County Grand Jury’s Report Entitled “A Diet For
  Landfills: Cutting Down on Food Waste”

  Moved to Consent Agenda

8.  Consideration of Issuing a Request for Proposals for a Grant Writer

  City Manager Guglielmo noted Councilmember Davidson’s request that this item be
  considered and presented the staff report.

  Karen Logan addressed the City Council.

STAFF REPORTS

  i.  City Manager's Report
  City Manager Guglielmo addressed a recent letter sent out to residents from the
  company that manages the City’s business licensing, noting that the City Council will
  be reviewing the Municipal Code at a future meeting. She also noted that a special
  meeting for the Pension Ad-Hoc Committee meeting would be taking place.

  a. State of the Police Department – Oral Report
  Captain Tony Best reported.

MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
September 22, 2020
 Councilmember Lozzi acknowledged and complimented Treasurer Ying, noted the Investment
Policy Advisory Committee meeting and provided an update on PV Transit.

Councilmember Davidson requested future agenda items for the Mirlo Gate Tower, City Council
Term Limits and use of concessions for generating revenue.

Mayor Pro Tem Kemps provided an update on the Fiber Circuit Connection project by the South
Bay Cities Council of Governments, and the potential for other companies to provide internet
options to peninsula residents.

Mayor McGowan noted ongoing communication with other Mayors and the Library District,
and discussions with local cities about disaster preparedness coordination.

ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, October 13, 2020 AT 6:30 P.M.

  ACTION: Moved by Mayor Pro Tem Kemps, Seconded by Councilmember Lozzi
  to adjourn the meeting at 8:44 p.m.

RESPECTFULLY SUBMITTED,

___________________________________
Kylynn Chaney, City Clerk
  APPROVED:

  ___________________________________
  David McGowan, Mayor

CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
September 22, 2020
